app_info.subtitle: Coordinate education work
app_info.description: Education Operation Center helps directors and adult staff at education centers coordinate instructor scheduling, family scheduling, and class scheduling; handle partner relationship interactions and invoicing; and access enrollment information and statuses through BOS. It brings focused education expertise to your AI workspace while BOS owns execution authority, business state, and permissions. Service infrastructure, authoritative data stores, and private implementation IP remain outside the agent host; authorized inputs and results, public skills, and permitted scoped caches can reach the agent. Trial reconciliation, camp capacity planning, reviewed family communications, and invoice exceptions are supporting workflow examples. In a synthetic example, Example Learning Center could reconcile example.test partnership invoices against payment records in its configured accounting system and prepare a source-linked exception ledger. Its skills can contribute domain goals and constraints to an ad hoc dynamic workflow; composition and control are owned by BOS when the required authoring and runtime contracts are available. The plugin requires BOS and its authenticated connection; deterministic workflow execution follows discovered HTTPS contracts, preserving human judgment, approvals, roles, provider boundaries, and source evidence. Available operations depend on authorized discovery, configuration, and provider readiness. Request an invite at https://dfsm.ai/apps/bos/#request-invite.

test_cases.description: Resolve the reviewer's authorized Education Center context and source readiness.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show which education center I am connected to and summarize the data sources available to me.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns exactly one authorized fictional review organization, the effective role, and a concise provider-readiness summary without opaque identifiers or credentials.

test_cases.description: Find fictional students and their active education records.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the synthetic students whose last name is Rivera and show their active education records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only matching fictional students with active class or enrollment facts and source attribution, omitting unnecessary internal identifiers.

test_cases.description: Request enrollment data for a fixed review week when Calimatic is not configured.
test_cases.user_prompt: List enrollments from September 14 through September 20, 2026, and group them by class.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks the reviewer to configure the Calimatic API key through BOS's secure configuration flow and returns no enrollment rows until configuration is complete. The API key stays out of chat.

test_cases.description: Produce a source-backed daily camp roster report and identify capacity evidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a roster report for the synthetic camps running September 14 through September 18, 2026, with per-day student counts and attendance evidence. State whether capacity and open-seat calculations are supported by the returned data.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns per-camp and per-day student counts and attendance evidence with source attribution; reports capacity and open seats only from explicit source evidence and otherwise states the missing capacity evidence.

test_cases.description: Find fictional students for a bounded family follow-up review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find synthetic students with active enrollment and identify missing or incomplete guardian contact fields. Show the enrollment and contact evidence supporting each flagged record.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only fictional students with active enrollment and demonstrably missing or incomplete returned guardian contact fields, preserves source evidence and names the missing fields without assuming a follow-up schedule.

test_cases.description: Discover the Education Center student-search tool through BOS Describe and authorized tool discovery.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use BOS Describe to inspect Education Center and list the tools advertised for my authorized context. Return the exact advertised tool name for Education Center student search.
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the Education Center student-search tool by its exact advertised name: education_center_search_students.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject access to another organization's private student and revenue records.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can I access student or revenue records from an education center where I have no membership? Explain the authorized scope boundary without reading or disclosing those records.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not search another organization and should explain that operations are limited to the reviewer's authorized tenant.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Education Operation Center for unrelated general knowledge.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to education-center operations or authorized business data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not treat an ambiguous request as authorization for an external communication.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send everyone in the database a promotional email now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should decline an unbounded send and require a permission-based audience, defined content and scope, and the workflow's required approval controls.
